name: Neon Alley Nocturne
promptTemplate: A rain-drenched dark brick alley bathed in the neon hum of {{alley_mood}} vibes, with hand-bent tubes glowing with {{glow_bloom}} radiance, {{flicker_intensity}} voltage instability, textured walls {{brick_texture}}, and erratic sputtering from the {{sputter_target}} sign.

alley_mood.hint: Swaps neon gas tube and reflection colors

sputter_target.hint: Chooses which sign starves for power

brick_texture.hint: Reveals the mortar and dark alley wall

listing.blurb: Luminous neon signs hum and flicker against a rain-drenched brick wall, casting glowing halos across the alley.
listing.prompt: A wall of hand-bent neon signs in a dark alley: glowing tubes shaping a cocktail glass, a palm, an arrow and a cursive OPEN, each with its own buzz and flicker, one sputtering on and off, the glass tubes and their back-painted gaps visible, a soft coloured haze on the brick. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
